node.statement: Take dagger of the equality in node 1.3.1. By node 1.2, tilde Q is Hermitian and every compressed product reverses exactly under dagger. Thus the daggered left side is x^dagger dot (z^dagger dot y) + (x^dagger dot z^dagger) dot y (the two summands may be reordered by commutativity of addition). The daggered scalar is conjugated, and conjugate symmetry plus the definition of the Hilbert-space adjoint give overline(<y,T x>)=<T x,y>=<x,T^dagger y>. Hence, for all x,y, (x^dagger dot z^dagger) dot y + x^dagger dot (z^dagger dot y) = 2 <x,T^dagger y> tilde Q.
